thread:
jordan_support: @here ACME-Health (acct: acme-123) reports Dedicated cluster in eu-central returning 429 / placement failures since ~06:10 UTC. Customers see token auth failures intermittently. They've escalated to Premium. :rotating_light:

liam_sre: do we have correlation_id / sample request? any rate-limit headers? can you paste the api response + x-request-id

jordan_support: curl output from customer (redacted):

```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/infer
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: rwd-7f8a9c2
retry-after: 30
content-type: application/json
{"error":"placement_failed","detail":"no available GPU capacity in eu-central"}
```

jordan_support: also seeing occasional 401s: "token invalid" — customer rotated keys earlier but still intermittent.

maria_ops: pulled autoscaler logs for dedicated-eu-central-01: several scale-up attempts hit cloud quota limit at 06:12 UTC. snippet:

```text
[2036-05-01T06:12:04Z] scaler: request_scale_up -> instances=+8
[2036-05-01T06:12:06Z] cloud_api -> error: QuotaExceeded: VM quota reached for eu-central
[2036-05-01T06:12:06Z] scaler -> backoff 30s
```

maria_ops: also seeing node OOM evictions on a high-util tenant (tenant=beta-ai) same timeframe — noisy neighbor suspected.

sam_engineer: recent autoscaler config change in canary lowered scale threshold ~05:55 UTC. Could be causing larger scale-ups and hitting quota. capacity-bot alert: CAPACITY_ALERT: gpu_pool_eu_central < 5% free

deploy-bot: config change: autoscaler.threshold=0.65 -> 0.55 by @sam_engineer (canary)

liam_sre: action plan:
1) throttle onboarding for new Dedicated allocs in eu-central (prevent additional placement attempts)
2) divert existing if possible to eu-west1 for premium customers (manual routing override)
3) request emergency quota bump from cloud provider + open ticket
4) isolate noisy tenant (beta-ai) and cordon nodes

irina_pm: I'll draft customer comms. Jordan, send holding note: short ETA + workaround to route to eu-west1.

jordan_support: sending holding note now: "We're experiencing regional GPU resource exhaustion in eu-central; temporary failover to eu-west1 is available. Working on remediation and will update in 30m." :thumbsup: 

sam_engineer: steps to divert traffic (ops-runbook snippet):

```yaml
routing_override:
  match: "acct:acme-123"
  prefer_regions: ["eu-west1"]
  fallback: "eu-central"
```

apply command:
``
redwoodctl route update --policy-file ./divert-acme.yaml
``

liam_sre: I've applied divert for acme-123 and two other premium tenants. Confirmed decreased placement attempts in eu-central.

maria_ops: manually cordoned 3 noisy nodes (beta-ai) and drained pods. freeing ~12 GPUs.

maria_ops: cloud provider responded to quota ticket: acknowledged, but normal processing ETA ~2 hours; they offered emergency quota if we provide justification (submitted).

sam_engineer: note — auth 401s look like token rotations colliding with our caching layer when we failover routes. Need to invalidate auth cache on routing change. I'll push a small hotfix.

sam_engineer: hotfix pushed to edge cache invalidation, rolling to 3/3 regions. deploy-bot: deploy rwd-edge-cache-invalidate v1.2.3 by @sam_engineer

capacity-bot: CAPACITY_RECOVERY: free_gpus_eu_central up from 3 -> 10 over 22m

maria_ops: metrics trending down, latency back to normal for diverted tenants. acme confirmed reduced errors.

irina_pm: next steps for postmortem and customer follow-up: collect autoscaler config change, noisy tenant attribution, timeline, cloud quota timeline, and comms copy. I'll own the postmortem.

jordan_support: customer happy with temporary failover, asked for ETA to return to eu-central. Proposed rollback when free_gpus_eu_central > 15 for 30m.

liam_sre: agree. schedule rollback and watch for auth errors. set canary for 5% traffic then ramp.

jordan_support: thanks team. closing incident channel when rollback complete. :white_check_mark:

sam_engineer: logging followups:
- create alert for cloud quota throttle
- revert aggressive autoscaler config in canary
- add noisy-tenant detection rule

liam_sre: filed followup tickets: INF-2309 (quota alert), INF-2310 (autoscaler rollback), INF-2311 (noisy tenant detector)

jordan_support: filing customer post-incident note now. tagging @irina_pm for review.

maria_ops: thumbs up. :thumbsup: 

capacity-bot: incident-2065178460 resolved — monitoring.
